name: TrueSignal decoy interaction
description: Baseline rule: any TrueSignal decoy alert not covered by a dedicated rule (scans, connections, queries, path probes, page views, file access and tampering). Every interaction with a decoy is suspicious by design; severity and risk follow the event. Beacons, receiver saturation, logins and honeytoken use have their own rules.
author: TrueSignal
false_positives: Monitoring (ICMP/uptime checks, SNMP pollers), backup and inventory agents reaching the decoys: add them to the whitelist or known scanners on the Hub.
note:
## Triage
1. `event.action` and `truesignal.details` say what was done; `threat.*` carries the ATT&CK mapping.
2. File Canary (`decoy_file_accessed`/`decoy_file_tampered`): `file.path` is the lure; find the process via EDR file telemetry on `host.name`.
3. Network decoys: identify `source.ip` and look for other TrueSignal alerts from it (scan-then-touch fires when it escalates).
query: event.dataset:"truesignal.alert" and event.kind:"alert" and not event.category:"authentication" and not event.action:("beacon_triggered" or "receiver_saturated") and not truesignal.whitelisted:true and not truesignal.known_scanner:true
